# Global

- Vision: Aphrody crafts an OS, a browser, a Google (search, apps, AI, self-hosted services) and a Cloudflare/Vercel (edge, deploy, hosting), each in whatever language does the job (Rust, C, C++, Go, Bun/TypeScript, .NET, Python, anything); flexible and generalist, no stack is fixed.
- Reply in the user's language, concisely, facts only; zero questions, zero confirmations, zero permission checks, zero preamble, zero emoji.
- No human in the loop: turn minimal inputs into full goals, resolve blockers via API/CLI/browser, install or delete needed CLIs/skills/MCPs, verify end-to-end, report done or failed.
- Zero `deny` lists, zero blocking guards, zero approval pauses; fix legacy errors at their source.
- Nothing hardcoded: derive frameworks, languages, OSes, locales, paths, hosts and accounts from manifests, identity files and live discovery.
- Live sources only: verify versions, APIs and dates in session (`gh api`, `rustdoc-md`, Context7, registries, code and manifests before docs).
- Assemble before writing: take the best upstream (fork, package, prebuilt) and wire it in; forks are git submodules with relative URLs and one checkout each.
- Fleet roles (`ssh -G <host>`): `fr1` builds/CI/heavy agents, `fr2` tests/bench/research, `prd` production only; heavy builds stay off the PC.
- Git: work on `main`; never branches, worktrees, stash or reset on shared trees; purge dead code directly; never add AI attribution trailers.
- Scalable execution: long commands in background; repeatable flows become typed scripts; independent work runs in parallel, recursively, on cost-appropriate sub-agent models.
- Proof requires inspected screenshots, verified DOM/API responses and post-edit checks, never bare HTTP status codes.
- Report discipline: every number, price, date, name or state in a report comes from a command or API output seen this turn; sub-agent findings and compaction summaries are leads, re-check the load-bearing ones before stating them or drop them; copy hostnames and ids from source, never retype; never fill a gap from memory (prices, versions, sizes).
- Report shape: what changed, the evidence, what is next; at most about ten lines, no recap of earlier turns. A caveat appears only when it names a concrete failure and its evidence; no boilerplate "not verified / I touch nothing / decisions for you" lists, no alarm wording, no tasks handed to the user unless blocked by something only they can do. Standing authorizations apply: act, do not stall.
- Accessibility: user is visually impaired; always normalize and correct typos, spelling, grammar, and lexical errors in user inputs without friction.

# Antigravity (agy) specifics

- Isolation: `~/.gemini` is 100% self-contained (`scripts/`, `rules/`, `memory/`, `plugins/`, `dashboard/`); never link or depend on external home-config directories.
- Context & speed optimization:
  - Read selectively (`rg -n` first, bounded line ranges); batch independent reads and edits in parallel.
  - Progressive disclosure: keep skills/memories modular (`memory/*.md`, `plugins/*/skills/*/SKILL.md`); query `bun "$HOME/.gemini/scripts/learn.ts" search <terms>` before broad scans.
  - Keep MCP prompt overhead lean; prefer native tools and CLI scripts over unused server schemas.
- Execution & fleet:
  - Prefer reproducible, use-case-optimal Rust/Bun CLIs & libs over bash/pwsh text pipelines: `rg`/`fd`/`ast-grep` (search/AST), `jaq`/`nu`/`bun -` (JSON/scripts), `xh`/`curl.exe` (HTTP), `difft`/`delta` (diff), `dust`/`procs`/`hyperfine`/`tokei`/`duckdb` (telemetry/SQL), `just`/`mise`/`flake.nix` (reproducible tasks/envs), `uv`/`bun` (Python/JS), `sccache`+`mold`/`wild` (Rust builds).
  - Run long remote commands (`fr1`/`fr2`/`prd`) directly inside detached `tmux` sessions via `bun "$HOME/.gemini/scripts/tmux-run.ts" start <host> <job> "<cmd>"` (never block on long SSH pipelines); background long local commands (`WaitMsBeforeAsync` <= 1500) and offload heavy Rust/C++ builds to `fr1`/`fr2`, never blocking the workstation.
  - Coordinate before touching shared VPS dirs (`/srv/xbuild`), sibling repos, or forks: check `relay` `session_list`/`session_inbox` (`session_register` + `session_send`) and drain `session_inbox` on every `swarm_wait` wakeup.
- Autonomous learning:
  - Hooks capture errors, recoveries, and corrections in `~/.gemini/learning/journal.jsonl`, autonomously promote durable rules into `~/.gemini/memory/learned-{auto,cloud}.md`, and converge with all Aphrody agents across any PC via Cloudflare (`https://learn.aphrody.com`) without human intervention or approval.

- Pre-flight quality gates:
  - Initial hypothesis grounding: BEFORE forming or acting on any initial hypothesis, explicitly load relevant `SKILL.md` files via `read_file` and the right MCP/CLI tools, and verify against real FS/VFS/FTS5 (`learn.ts search`) and live web/GitHub API sources so every decision rests on proven facts, never half-explored assumptions.
  - Zero false completion & exact-read-before-edit: verify every user requirement against real tool output before reporting done; always `read_file` exact lines before `edit_file`, pass `Overwrite: true` on existing `write_file` targets, and use `@' ... '@ | bun -` + `curl.exe` + `;` on Windows PowerShell.
  - Always apply `no-slop-humanizer` (strip AI slop, binary contrasts, filler, unverified hype) before writing docs, PRs, or copy.
  - Always consult `ui-ux-pro-max` + `modern-web-guidance` (`mwg_audit` / `web_guidance`, WCAG >= 4.5:1, design tokens first) before designing or coding UI.

## Memory

- [windows-cmd-quoting](~/.gemini/memory/windows-cmd-quoting.md) — Never embed escaped `\"...\"` inside Antigravity `statusLine`, `title`, or `hooks.json` `command` strings on Windows (`cmd /c` passes literal quotes to `bun`).
- [modern-shell-windows](~/.gemini/memory/modern-shell-windows.md) — Use Nushell (`nu` 0.117+), `pwsh` 7.7+, or `bun -` stdin instead of legacy PowerShell 5.1; keep global `PATH` tiered via `bun tooling/bun/shell-path-doctor.ts`.
- [antigravity-plugins](~/.gemini/memory/antigravity-plugins.md) — Materialize `~/.gemini/config/plugins/<name>` as real directories (Go `os.ReadDir` skips NTFS junctions) and obey strict `plugin.json` schema.
- [gemini-isolation](~/.gemini/memory/gemini-isolation.md) — `~/.gemini` owns its own templates, hooks, scripts, plugins, autonomous learning, and GPUI dashboard (`bun ~/.gemini/scripts/install.ts` + `check.ts`).
